# Hedwig

> Hedwig is an AI security expert for agentic finance. It helps payment agents catch transaction mistakes before signing and gives owners findings they can understand.

## Pages

- [Hedwig | AI security expert for agentic finance](https://usehedwig.xyz/): Hedwig is an AI security expert for agentic finance. It helps payment agents catch transaction mistakes before signing and gives owners findings they can understand.
- [About | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/about): Our vision is a payment-security model trained on curated DeFi and security data, with RAG bringing relevant protocol knowledge into each assessment.
- [How it works | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/how-it-works): The workflow we are building combines current chain facts with relevant DeFi and security knowledge. Agents get a score; owners can ask for the reasons.
- [Proof | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/proof): Inspect a recorded Solana devnet run covering an allowed request, an amount over the limit, missing evidence and a revoked role.
- [Roadmap | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/roadmap): Our roadmap combines a specialist payment-security model with RAG-backed protocol knowledge, starting with Monad and Tempo assessments.
- [Team | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/team): Hi, I'm Gabe. I'm focused full time on Hedwig.
- [Docs | Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/docs): Connect Hedwig through local MCP, set your policy and inspect a sample payment check. Your application controls signing.
- [Try Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents): Connect Hedwig to a coding agent that supports local MCP tools. Copy the setup prompt, approve the install and run a sample check.

## Setup

These guides install v0.4.2. Newer changes on main may use different configuration.

- [Consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agents.md): local setup and owner approval.
- [When to consult Hedwig](https://usehedwig.xyz/agentskill.md): payment checks through MCP.
- [Source](https://github.com/gabchess/hedwig)
